blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Pacific Ring of Fire houses the vast majority of the world's active volcanoes.
Mid-ocean ridges form as a result of tectonic plates pulling apart at divergent boundaries.
The East African Rift is a prime example of volcanic activity driven by continental rifting.
The Mediterranean belt features prominent European volcanic centers, including Italian volcanoes.
Hotspot volcanoes, such as those forming the Hawaiian islands, develop independently away from plate boundaries.

blocks.content: • Mid-ocean ridges — formed at divergent boundaries.

items: Hotspots like Hawaii are frequently tested as classic exceptions because they occur intraplate (away from plate boundaries).
